Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.

- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)

- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).

- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.

- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.

- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.

- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;

  • Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
  • Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
  • Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;
  • Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ;
  • Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation).

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution

jobs.description:
Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to one day a week on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 3+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

jobs.description:
Senior IT Engineer

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

jobs.title: Head of Partner Programs, Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Head of Partner Programs, Strategy and Operations

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As the Head of Partner Operations, you will build and own the operating system that allows Apollo's Partnerships business to scale. Sitting within Revenue Operations, you will be the connective tissue between partner strategy and the company-wide systems, data, processes, and commercial infrastructure that make partner motions work.

This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal. Partner Managers own relationships and execution; you own the operational infrastructure underneath them and you’ll help co-author our partner strategy. You'll establish the metrics and reporting that leadership uses to understand partner performance, architect the processes and systems that support different partner motions, and ensure the commercial mechanics behind those motions work reliably.

You'll operate across Apollo's technology, agency, integration, and strategic partner ecosystem. The goal isn't simply to make today's processes run better. It's to build a scalable Partner Operations function that can absorb new partner motions, eliminate operational friction, and give the business a clear understanding of where partnerships are creating revenue and where the model needs to evolve.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to build a function, not inherit a playbook.

Partnerships is becoming an increasingly important part of Apollo's revenue ecosystem, but partner motions create a unique operational challenge: the work crosses organizational boundaries, the data often lives across multiple systems, and the right operating model changes as the business learns.

The Head of Partner Operations will be responsible for turning that complexity into leverage. You'll help define how Apollo measures partner impact, how partner motions are structured, how systems support them, and how the company can scale partner revenue without scaling operational overhead at the same rate.

The strongest person in this role will leave the Partnerships organization with something substantially better than they found it: a clear operating model, trusted data, scalable systems, reliable commercial mechanics, and a set of partner motions that can evolve without rebuilding the infrastructure from scratch.

What You'll Do

Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Build the operating system for Partnerships. Establish the processes, systems, data model, and governance that allow Partnerships to operate as a measurable, scalable revenue channel. Define clear ownership across Partner Managers, RevOps, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders, and create the operating cadence that keeps the machine running.
  • Architect partner motions and commercial models. Partner with the VP of Partnerships and RevOps to design how different partner motions should work end-to-end, from acquisition and qualification through onboarding, activation, revenue generation, expansion, and renewal. Translate strategy into concrete operating models, including workflows, incentives, tiering, deal mechanics, attribution, systems requirements, and measurement.
  • Create a trusted measurement layer for the partner business. Own the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership visibility into partner-driven performance. Establish the operating definitions, instrumentation, dashboards, and recurring reporting for metrics such as the agency funnel, integration adoption, Partner-Involved ARR, sourced/influenced/managed attribution, and partner cohort NRR. Partner with RevOps, Finance and Analytics, while owning the operationalization and ongoing reliability of the resulting metrics.
  • Turn partner data into a decision-making system. Build the mechanisms that allow Partnerships and company leadership to understand which partners, motions, and investments are driving outcomes. Identify gaps in data quality and attribution, establish clear data ownership, and drive remediation upstream. Help drive decisions about where to invest, what to scale, and what to change.
  • Own the partner systems architecture in partnership with Systems. Translate partnership requirements into a coherent systems roadmap spanning Salesforce, PartnerStack, Crossbeam, Apollo, and other connected tooling. Work with Systems and Data Engineering to ensure partner data is captured correctly, flows between systems, and remains usable for reporting and automation. You won't be the administrator for every system; you'll own the requirements, architecture, prioritization, and operating model that make those systems work together.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity to execution. Partnerships will generate problems that don't fit neatly inside one team's ownership. You'll take ambiguous business needs, turn them into structured requirements, identify the right owners, and drive execution. You are accountable for getting the operating model to a working state even when you don't directly own every component.
  • Continuously improve the economics and efficiency of the partner motion, but not at the expense of growth. Use operational data to identify friction, leakage, and unnecessary manual work across the partner lifecycle. Develop the business case for process changes, automation, or new tooling, and measure whether those investments actually improve partner productivity, revenue contribution, data quality, or operating leverage.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Partner Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related function, with experience operating in a B2B SaaS environment and working across multiple GTM functions. Must have direct experience in Partnerships within this.
  • Experience building an operating function from the ground up. You've created processes, systems, reporting, and governance where there wasn't previously a mature operating model, and you know how to balance getting today's work done with building what will replace it.
  • Strong understanding of partnerships and partner-led motions. You understand the operational mechanics behind agencies, technology/integration partners, channel programs, strategic partnerships, or similar ecosystems. You understand how partner economics, attribution, incentives, deal registration, and partner lifecycle management work.
  • A systems thinker with a builder's bias. You naturally look for the underlying system behind a recurring problem. Rather than building another workaround, you ask what process, data model, workflow, or automation would prevent the problem from happening again.
  • Strong analytical instincts. You're comfortable working with funnel, pipeline, revenue, cohort, and attribution data and can move between executive-level business questions and the underlying data required to answer them. You know how to distinguish a measurement problem from a business problem.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership without relying on formal authority. You can align multiple XFN Stakeholders around a shared operating model, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive work to completion even when the underlying components are owned by different teams.
  • Strategic and operational range. You can participate in a conversation about the future of Apollo's partner strategy in the morning and then get into the details of an attribution definition, Salesforce workflow, or revenue-share process in the afternoon.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Partner motions are still being built. You should be comfortable creating structure where there isn't much, making decisions with incomplete information, and iterating quickly as the business learns.
  • Strong written and verbal communicator. You can write a crisp operating proposal, explain a complex systems dependency to an executive, turn an ambiguous request into requirements for Engineering, and create documentation that a broader team can actually use.
  • High ownership and strong judgment. You know which problems require a durable solution, which can be handled pragmatically, and when to pull in the right functional owner. You optimize for the health of the overall revenue system rather than protecting functional boundaries.

AI Fluency & Tooling

Apollo operates at the intersection of AI and go-to-market, and our Revenue Operations organization is expected to lead from the front. This role requires genuine fluency in leveraging AI as part of how you operate and build.

That means:

Using LLMs as an active operating partner. Whether you're analyzing partner performance, developing SQL, drafting requirements, documenting processes, investigating data quality issues, or preparing an executive recommendation, you should be reaching for AI tools wherever they can materially accelerate your work.

Designing partner operations for an AI-native environment. Think beyond dashboards and workflows toward how structured partner data, documentation, and operating context can be made accessible to AI agents and internal tools. You should understand the importance of clean schemas, canonical definitions, semantic documentation, and reliable system interfaces.

Using AI to increase operating leverage. The expectation is that a single operator can accomplish substantially more by combining strong judgment with AI-assisted analysis, development, automation, and documentation.

Staying ahead of the tooling curve. The AI tooling landscape is moving quickly. We're looking for someone who experiments, learns independently, shares what works, and continuously looks for ways to replace manual operational work with better systems.

Knowing where AI should and shouldn't be trusted. AI can accelerate analysis and execution, but it can also introduce hallucinations, incorrect assumptions, and false confidence. You should have strong enough operational and analytical judgment to validate AI-generated outputs and know when first-principles analysis is required.

Scope & Ownership

Partner Operations sits within Revenue Operations and owns the infrastructure that makes the Partnerships business measurable and scalable.

Partner Operations owns:

  • Partner-business reporting, measurement, and recurring instrumentation
  • Partner data quality and attribution
  • Partner systems requirements, architecture, and operating processes
  • Partner lifecycle and funnel instrumentation
  • Deal-registration and commercial operations
  • Partner agreement and amendment administration in partnership with Legal
  • Revenue-share operational tracking and payout process coordination with Finance
  • Partner-related data requests and cross-functional operational workflows
  • Design and documentation of partner operating models and processes
  • Requirements and coordination for systems and data builds
  • Continuous improvement and automation of partner operations

Partner Operations partners with, but does not replace:

  • Partner Managers, who own partner relationships, partner strategy, and commercial relationships
  • Systems, who own company-wide systems administration and technical implementation
  • Data Engineering / RevOps Analytics, who own underlying data infrastructure and statistical methodology where applicable
  • Finance, who owns financial controls and payout execution
  • Legal, who owns legal review and contractual risk
  • BizOps, who provides strategic guidance and project support on broader cross-functional initiatives
  • Partner Marketing / Academy, who own co-marketing strategy and certification/badge program design
  • Partnerships technical resources, who may build lightweight agents, automations, or prototypes outside the core company-wide systems infrastructure

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$184,000—$270,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$160,000—$238,000 USD

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

You will own the partner relationship and be accountable for the partner-sourced and

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. This is a revenue-generating role with a base-plus-variable compensation structure tied to partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

Preferred

  • Experience managing partner tiers, designations, specializations and marketplace listings (for example, cloud marketplace listings and partner designations).

Health can’t wait.

Alan exists to end the wait.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Strategic Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Southern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and GP growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.

  • Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base.

Desired:

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Organic Growth Manager (SEO & AI Search)

Your Mission

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're reconnecting one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries with AI: general contractors publish their tenders on Cosuno and find the right subcontractors, and subcontractors find the projects that fit them and win more of them. As our Organic Growth Manager, you make Cosuno the answer when contractors and trade firms search, on Google and in AI assistants: through our blog, our website and Marketplace pages, and the sources AI answers rely on. And you join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, the website relaunch with our agency, which you'll use to grow organic traffic significantly. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you'll do

  • You build our blog into a steady source of qualified sign-ups: an editorial plan from search data, sales calls and trade press, original research from our platform data, and customer stories, written to a high German standard with freelance writers and AI tools.

  • You own website SEO: public Marketplace pages, landing pages and programmatic trade and region pages, plus technical health, structure and speed.

  • You make Cosuno the source AI assistants cite (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, structured content and a tracked set of the prompts our customers ask.

  • You start our content partnerships: guest posts, joint studies and collaborations with trade media and partners that earn links and mentions. Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you also keep organic LinkedIn and our founders' posts running, then hand them over.

  • Your big project in year one: the website relaunch. Our agency builds the new site and owns sitemap and design; you are their SEO sparring partner and the owner of SEO for the move: you set the requirements, challenge the structure, own redirects and migration checks, and turn the relaunch into a clear jump in organic traffic. Until it goes live, you make the small changes on the current site that matter most.

  • You use AI to make organic faster and better: with our GTM & Growth Engineer you keep automating research, briefs, content and reporting, and test new formats, landing pages and free tools built on our platform data. You pick the smart solution, not the shiny one, and scale what brings sign-ups.

  • You measure the path from impression to qualified sign-up and demo request, and report what organic contributes.

What You Bring

  • You've owned SEO and content for a B2B or two-sided platform and can show growth in qualified sign-ups or pipeline, not just rankings.

  • Strong technical SEO: you've owned SEO through a site migration or relaunch and grown traffic through it.

  • Hands-on experience with AI search and how language models choose their sources.

  • You write excellent German, brief writers well and turn data into blog posts and stories that search, AI answers and journalists pick up.

  • You're data-driven and at home in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar.

  • You work AI-first: you set the strategy, automate what can be automated with our engineer and steer writers and the agency, rather than write everything yourself. You get things done and learn fast in a small team.

  • Native-level German and fluent English: most of our content is German.

Your Benefits

  • Room to shape and grow: You own organic growth from the ground up, including the website relaunch, our biggest marketing project of the year.

  • AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

Compensation: €60K – €70K

Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution.

L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage.

Ce stage combine gestion de projet, communication client, accompagnement au changement, analyse de données et compréhension des environnements informatiques hospitaliers.

Tes missions

Piloter la communication autour de la migration

Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration :

  • Préparation des messages de premier contact ;

  • Adaptation des communications selon le niveau d’avancement des clients ;

  • Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ;

  • Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires.

Prioriser les migrations

Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères :

  • Taille et typologie des établissements ;

  • Niveau de maturité ou de préparation technique ;

  • Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ;

  • Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ;

  • Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire.

L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique.

Mettre en place un tableau de suivi et des outils de reporting

Tu concevras et maintiendras un tableau de bord permettant de suivre l’avancement global de la migration, notamment :

  • Nombre de clients contactés ;

  • Taux de réponse et de relance ;

  • Principales raisons de blocage ;

  • Actions réalisées et prochaines étapes ;

  • Indicateurs d’adoption et d’utilisation.

Tu t’appuieras notamment sur Mixpanel et sur les outils internes disponibles afin de fiabiliser le suivi et de produire des reportings réguliers à destination des équipes concernées.

Accompagner les clients

  • Suivi des situations nécessitant un accompagnement personnalisé ;

Préparer le transfert à l’équipe Support

Une partie importante du stage consistera à préparer la reprise du suivi par l’équipe Support :

Nous recherchons surtout une personne :

Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Security Architect

Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Trade Compliance
Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff DevOps Engineer

Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer. You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us?

What tech stack do we have for you?

  • Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab
  • Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub
  • Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry
  • Python, Golang

Minimum requirements:

At least 5 years of production experience with:

  • Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production
  • GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives
  • Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance

If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244, Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243

How to know if you are a good fit:

The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position:

  • Design and Specification: You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others.
  • Cross-team Leadership: You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you.
  • Independent Delivery: You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made.
  • AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement: You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship.
  • Continuous Learning: You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them.
  • Conference Participation: You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field.
  • Configuration Proficiency: You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few.
  • Resource Optimization: You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs).
  • Cluster Management: You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster.
  • Terraform Proficiency: You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus.
  • DevOps and CI/CD Experience: You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker.
  • Team Onboarding and Training: You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth.

About your team:

The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications.

The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization.

Tasks and responsibilities:

In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required.

You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.
