jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for driving adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion within a defined portfolio of customers. You will act as the primary post‑sales relationship owner, orchestrating the right resources across Support, Product, Services, and Sales to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and view us as a strategic partner.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Outcomes & Revenue

  • Own customer health, retention, and risk management for your portfolio, in partnership with Sales and Renewals.
  • Build, maintain, and execute customer success plans for priority accounts, with clear business outcomes, milestones, and owners.
  • Proactively identify renewal and churn risk, create save plans, and track mitigation activities.
  • Surface and qualify expansion opportunities (cross‑sell, up‑sell, use‑case expansion) and collaborate with Sales/Account Management to progress them.

2. Adoption & Value Realisation

  • Translate customer objectives into measurable outcomes and ensure progress is tracked and communicated.
  • Regularly review usage data, health scores, and telemetry to spot gaps, drive adoption plays, and prevent value erosion.
  • Deliver value‑focused reviews (e.g., Success Plan /EBRs), telling a clear story that connects product usage to business results.

3. Customer Engagement & Advocacy

  • Build and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with day‑to‑day contacts, project owners, and business sponsors.
  • Run a structured cadence of check‑ins, workshops, and governance reviews, tailored to customer segment and lifecycle stage.
  • Capture and share customer feedback, ensuring issues are followed through to resolution and learnings are socialized internally.
  • Identify and develop customer advocates for references, testimonials, case studies, and events.

4. Operational Excellence & Tooling

  • Keep customer records accurate and up‑to‑date in CS tools and CRM (health scores, notes, success plans, risks, and actions).
  • Use standardized playbooks and processes for adoption, development, and renewal preparation.
  • Prepare and maintain account success plans that give leadership clear visibility into status, risk, and opportunity.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of CS processes, templates, and best practices.

5. Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales/Account Executives on account strategy, renewal preparation, and executive engagement.
  • Work with Support and Engineering to manage escalations, communicate status to customers, and prevent repeat issues.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and CS Architecture/Onboarding to share customer insights and influence roadmap and enablement.
  • Coordinate with Professional Services on project scoping, delivery alignment, and handoffs.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, or similar customer‑facing role in B2B SaaS / enterprise software.
  • Proven track record managing a portfolio of mid‑ to large‑enterprise customers and delivering against retention targets.
  • Strong understanding of subscription / recurring revenue models and the drivers of churn and expansion.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical and non‑technical stakeholders (from admins to Director/VP level).
  • Comfortable working with data and dashboards (usage, health, NPS/CSAT) and turning insights into clear actions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), security, or adjacent enterprise SaaS.
  • Hands‑on experience with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) and CRM (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience running QBRs/EBRs and building structured success plans.
  • Exposure to working with distributed / global teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Customer Success Manager will be measured on a combination of:

  • Renewal Rate for assigned accounts.
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) / expansion pipeline influenced or sourced.
  • Portfolio health: average health score, coverage and freshness of success plans,
  • Strategic Touchpoint Delivery - EBR’s, Value Unlocks, Road Maps, Success Plan Reviews..
  • Customer advocacy and satisfaction: NPS/CSAT scores, references, and participation in marketing/customer programs.
  • Operational excellence: data quality in systems, timely updates, and adherence to core CS processes.

Behaviours & Values

  • Customer‑obsessed: consistently acts in the best interest of the customer and their outcomes.
  • Data‑informed: uses metrics and evidence to guide decisions and prioritization.

jobs.description:
National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d)

Deine Rolle bei Tekpoint

Du kennst den deutschen DIY-Handel, verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern und weißt, wie man Marken erfolgreich im Baumarktgeschäft positioniert? Du verstehst die Strukturen des Handels, kennst die Abläufe im Zentraleinkauf und weißt, worauf es bei Listungen, Sortimenten, Platzierungen und der Umsetzung am Point of Sale ankommt?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Als National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die strategische und operative Entwicklung unserer bestehenden Handelspartner sowie die Gewinnung neuer Kunden im deutschen DIY-Markt. Du entwickelst Geschäftsbeziehungen auf zentraler Ebene weiter, erschließt neue Umsatzpotenziale und baust die Distribution unserer Marken und Produkte nachhaltig aus.

Dabei arbeitest du mit einem vielseitigen Portfolio namhafter Technologiemarken wie Roborock, Segway Navimow, Xiaomi und Govee sowie weiteren innovativen Marken und Produktkategorien. Von Bodenpflege und Rasenrobotik über Beleuchtung bis hin zu weiteren Consumer-Electronics- und Home-Technologie-Produkten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Handelspartnern attraktive Sortimente und erfolgreiche Vermarktungskonzepte.

Du verbindest strategisches Key Account Management mit ausgeprägter Neukundenorientierung und einem tiefen Verständnis für die operativen Anforderungen des deutschen DIY-Handels. Du weißt, wie Entscheidungen im Zentraleinkauf getroffen werden, wie regionale Strukturen funktionieren und wie aus einer Listung ein nachhaltig erfolgreiches Geschäft entsteht.

Bei der Umsetzung deiner Kundenstrategien arbeitest du eng mit unserem Area Sales Management sowie den internen Teams aus Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an den Director Sales Deutschland und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unseres DIY-Geschäfts aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Key Account Management & Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für bestehende Key Accounts und entwickelst diese strategisch und operativ weiter.

  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Handelspartner und erschließt zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Du baust nachhaltige Geschäftsbeziehungen zu relevanten Entscheidern im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management auf und entwickelst dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du erarbeitest kundenindividuelle Geschäfts- und Wachstumspläne und setzt diese konsequent um.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kunden neue Sortiments-, Listungs- und Vermarktungsmöglichkeiten für unser Markenportfolio.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Absatz- und Margenentwicklung deiner Accounts und stellst eine nachhaltige, profitable Geschäftsentwicklung sicher.

2. Kundenbeziehungen, Verhandlungen & Vertragsmanagement

  • Du führst Jahresgespräche, Sortimentsverhandlungen und Vertragsverhandlungen eigenständig und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Du verhandelst Listungen, Konditionen, Rahmenvereinbarungen, Marketingbudgets und Promotions.

  • Du verstehst die Entscheidungswege und Prozesse deiner Handelspartner und nutzt dieses Wissen gezielt zur Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Du identifizierst zusätzliche Potenziale innerhalb bestehender Kundenorganisationen und baust die Zusammenarbeit auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen aus.

  • Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, erkennst Marktchancen frühzeitig und setzt diese in konkrete Geschäftsergebnisse um.

3. Sortimentsentwicklung, Distribution & Point of Sale

  • Du treibst die Listung und den Ausbau unserer Marken und Produktkategorien bei relevanten DIY-Handelspartnern voran.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Kunden attraktive Sortimente und überzeugende Produktplatzierungen.

  • Du kennst die Abläufe und Anforderungen im deutschen Baumarkthandel und weißt, wie nationale Vereinbarungen in die regionalen Strukturen und Märkte übertragen werden.

  • Du verhandelst und koordinierst Regalplatzierungen, Zweitplatzierungen, Aktionsflächen und saisonale Verkaufsmaßnahmen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Area Sales Management zusammen, um vereinbarte Maßnahmen in den Märkten erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Du analysierst Sell-in- und Sell-out-Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Distribution, Abverkauf und Markenpräsenz ab.

  • Du begleitest Produkteinführungen und entwickelst neue Vermarktungsansätze für unser vielseitiges Marken- und Produktportfolio.

4. Markt- und Kundenentwicklung

  • Du beobachtest Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Sortimentsentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du analysierst Kundenpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für die Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner.

  • Du baust bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen aus und erschließt zusätzliche Umsatzpotenziale durch neue Produkte, Sortimente und Vertriebskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsame Wachstumsinitiativen mit unseren Handelspartnern und überführst diese in konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du bringst deine Marktkenntnis und dein Netzwerk aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie ein.

5. Steuerung & Zusammenarbeit

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Margen- und Budgetplanung deiner Accounts sowie eine belastbare Forecast-Qualität.

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Area Sales Management, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Warenverfügbarkeit, Lieferperformance und interne Prozesse die vereinbarten Kundenaktivitäten unterstützen.

  • Du überwachst relevante KPIs, erstellst Business Reviews und leitest bei Abweichungen geeignete Maßnahmen ein.

  • Du berichtest regelmäßig an den Director Sales Deutschland und sorgst für Transparenz über Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenpotenziale und Vertriebsmaßnahmen.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachliche Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Key Account Management des deutschen DIY-Handels.

  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern im deutschen Baumarkthandel, insbesondere im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Strukturen, Entscheidungswege und Abläufe deutscher Baumarktketten sowie idealerweise regionaler Handelsorganisationen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden, der Umsetzung von Listungen und dem Ausbau bestehender Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresgesprächen, Konditionsverhandlungen, Sortimentsentscheidungen und der wirtschaftlichen Steuerung von Kundenaccounts.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Distribution, Platzierungsmanagement, POS-Aktivierung und Sell-out-Steuerung.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Vertriebsstrukturen und im Zusammenspiel zwischen zentralen Vereinbarungen und deren Umsetzung in den Märkten.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und ein sicherer Umgang mit Umsatz-, Margen- und Abverkaufsdaten.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung bei einem Markenhersteller oder Lieferanten aus dem DIY-, Home-, Garden- oder Consumer-Electronics-Umfeld mit. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass du bereits exakt unsere Produktkategorien betreut hast, sondern dass du den deutschen DIY-Handel verstehst, über die richtigen Kontakte verfügst und nachweislich Geschäft entwickeln kannst.

Deine Persönlichkeit

  • Du bist eine überzeugende Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die auf Augenhöhe mit Einkäufern und Entscheidern kommuniziert.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktchancen und kommerzielle Zusammenhänge.

  • Du kombinierst strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzungsstärke und einem ausgeprägten Abschlusswillen.

  • Du gehst aktiv auf neue Kunden zu, baust Netzwerke aus und entwickelst bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du verhandelst souverän, handelst unternehmerisch und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen Verhandlungen deine Ziele im Blick.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Kunden und Ergebnisse.

  • Du schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team und weißt, wie du gemeinsam mit dem Area Sales Management und internen Schnittstellen nachhaltiges Wachstum erzielst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Entwicklung unseres Geschäfts im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Die Möglichkeit, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen auszubauen und neue Handelspartner für unser Markenportfolio zu gewinnen.

  • Ein vielseitiges Portfolio mit etablierten und innovativen Marken wie Roborock, Segway Navimow, Xiaomi und Govee sowie weiteren spannenden Produktkategorien.

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege mit direkter Anbindung an das Management.

  • Unterstützung durch unser Area Sales Management bei der Umsetzung von Kundenstrategien und Vertriebsmaßnahmen in den Märkten.

  • Einen Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

  • Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten inklusive Homeoffice.

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und die Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Teams aus Vertrieb, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain.

  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und attraktive zusätzliche Benefits.

Bereit, den deutschen DIY-Markt mit uns weiterzuentwickeln?

Du verfügst über das richtige Netzwerk, kennst den Handel aus der Praxis und möchtest mit starken Marken neue Geschäftspotenziale erschließen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Your mission is to take a client who has seen the initial spark of value and guide them toward full-scale AI transformation. jobs.title: Pentester confirmé - Red Team
jobs.description:
Pentester confirmé - Red Team

Ballpoint est une société de cybersécurité offensive spécialisée dans les tests d'intrusion, les audits de sécurité, les exercices de red team et la formation continue. Nous innovons également avec Trapster, notre solution de honeypot conçue pour améliorer la détection d'intrusion au sein des entreprises.

Nous sommes une équipe de 7 passionnés, avec une forte culture technique, et nous collaborons avec une clientèle variée, du secteur public aux PME en passant par les SOC et MSSP.

Le télétravail est possible régulièrement, mais ce poste demande une présence à Paris.

Vos missions

Vous travaillerez au cœur de l'équipe pentest pour réaliser des audits, évaluer les vulnérabilités et améliorer la posture de sécurité de nos clients, tout en prenant progressivement la main sur la structuration et la croissance de l'activité.

Concrètement :

  • Réaliser des audits de sécurité et tests d'intrusion (Web, Active Directory, Mobile, IoT…)

  • Participer aux exercices Red Team (contournement EDR, spear-phishing, infra, intrusion physique…)

  • Développer et utiliser des outils de pentest personnalisés

  • Participer à l'élaboration de formations et de sensibilisations

  • Contribuer à la rédaction d'articles techniques

Et, à mesure que vous montez en responsabilité :

  • Structurer et faire grandir la practice pentest (méthodologie, outillage, qualité des livrables)

  • Encadrer et former les profils juniors (stagiaires, futurs recrutements)

  • Participer aux choix techniques de l'équipe et à l'évolution de notre offre

  • Être force de proposition sur la direction technique de Ballpoint

Le périmètre s'ajuste selon votre profil et vos ambitions : plus vous voulez prendre, plus il y a à prendre.

Vos compétences

Vous avez déjà une expérience solide en pentest et :

  • Maîtrise des outils de pentest et de leurs limites

  • Usage courant des outils IA (automatisation, scripting, agents…)

  • Aisance avec le scripting ou la programmation (Python, Bash, PowerShell…)

  • Bonne connaissance des vulnérabilités courantes (injection SQL, XSS, CSRF, dépassement de tampon, etc.) et des concepts réseau/systèmes

  • Fort intérêt pour la sécurité offensive et la veille technologique

  • Autonomie, esprit d'équipe, capacité à prendre des initiatives et envie de faire grandir une structure

  • Anglais courant (rédaction de rapports, veille internationale)

Une appétence ou une première expérience d'encadrement est un vrai plus.

Avantages

Vous profiterez d'une vraie liberté d'action et de responsabilités dès votre arrivée. Ici, votre avis compte vraiment sur nos projets et nos méthodes.

Vous travaillerez sur des missions variées, ce qui garantit que vous ne vous ennuierez jamais.

Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)

À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

You'll take ownership of Agile delivery effectiveness across one or more defence software Squads, working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex priorities into predictable, sustainable delivery.

This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), where Senior Scrum Masters contribute not only to team success, but also to the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the wider organisation.

You'll operate in a multi-Squad environment with dependencies spanning engineering, product, documentation and customer-facing teams. The role extends beyond a single Squad and requires the ability to influence outcomes across organisational boundaries.


Your Mission

What you'll do

  • Create the conditions for effective delivery, ensuring Agile events, stakeholder interactions and team collaboration help Squads make informed decisions, maintain momentum and deliver valuable outcomes.

  • Coordinate with Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic delivery challenges.
  • Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across ILIAS.

What success looks like
Your Squads deliver valuable outcomes predictably and sustainably, while collaboration across teams continues to improve. Product, Engineering and business stakeholders understand priorities, risks and dependencies early enough to act on them rather than react to them.

Teams take ownership of their commitments and continuously improve how they work, using Agile practices as tools for delivery rather than goals in themselves.

Stakeholders trust delivery forecasts because expectations are clear, communication is transparent and progress is visible.

As a Senior Scrum Master, you'll work closely with Market Product Managers, engineers, Tech Writers and leadership teams to support the delivery of mission-critical software used by defence organisations worldwide.

By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

A small number of Apollo's partners account for the majority of partner-driven revenue — and how well Apollo manages those relationships has an outsized effect on the business. Apollo has thousands of partners who've raised their hand, and a named-partner motion that's still being built to actually activate and grow the best of them into that tier. As Partner Account Manager (PAM), you'll own a focused, named book of Apollo's highest-value partners (roughly 20–30) once they've proven sustained activity and strategic importance.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not inheriting a mature program, you're helping define what high-touch partner management looks like at Apollo. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping the program's future, not just running an existing playbook.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into durable growth for our most important partners.

This isn't a maintenance role — it's a growth lever. You'll build joint business plans with each partner, run the operating cadence that keeps both sides accountable, grow managed ARR and customer outcomes alongside Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps, and make the call on when a partner is ready to progress, needs support, or should step back from named coverage.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Named Partner Book

  • Maintain a live account plan for every partner in your book — segment, tier, health status, IPP score, and next milestone
  • Flag at-risk accounts before they become escalations
  • Serve as the system of record for who's in the book and why

Build Joint Business Plans

  • Co-create mutual goals with each partner: target segments, pipeline objectives, managed-customer growth targets
  • Build certification and enablement plans directly into the joint business plan, not as a side conversation
  • Set the co-marketing and executive-alignment agenda for the period

Grow Managed ARR and Customer Outcomes

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to find expansion opportunities inside partner-managed accounts
  • Monitor adoption and usage signals closely enough to catch churn or delivery risk before it shows up in retention
  • Bring data — not anecdotes — to internal reviews of what's working across the managed book

Run the Operating Cadence

  • Run regular 1:1 check-ins and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with every named partner
  • For top-tier partners, lead a deeper annual strategic review with a standing recommendation prepared in advance
  • Come to every touchpoint with the latest scorecard pulled and open items tracked

Maintain Standing and Progression

  • Track certification coverage, customer quality, and routing eligibility on an ongoing basis, not just at review time
  • Build promotion, remediation, or downgrade recommendations on consistent criteria, not gut feel
  • Own accountability internally whenever a partner's standing is in question

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in partner/channel account management, customer success, or strategic account management, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of external relationships against mutual growth goals (joint business plans, QBRs, or equivalent)
  • Comfortable owning revenue-adjacent outcomes (managed ARR, NRR, retention) in partnership with Sales, CS, and RevOps
  • Strong executive presence — able to run a quarterly business review and represent Apollo credibly to partner leadership
  • Organized and data-driven, with experience maintaining account plans, scorecards, and health tracking across a named book

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems
  • Experience managing a tiered partner book (e.g., strategic/named tiers with differentiated cadence and service levels)
  • Familiarity with partner/channel platforms (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)
  • Background working alongside Partner Marketing on co-marketing, case studies, or joint events
  • Experience in a GTM, sales-engagement, or RevOps ecosystem

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. jobs.title: Principal Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
Principal Technical Consultant

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services.

You will:

  • Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more.
  • Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs.
  • Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations.
  • Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients.
  • Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements.
  • Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise.
  • Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies.
  • Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles).
  • Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment.
  • Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources.
  • Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early.
  • Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations.
  • Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed.
  • Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning.
  • Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery.
  • Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience working in a consulting capacity with a minimum of 2 years working directly in the Identity and Access Management space within a large organization or enterprise
  • Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience
  • A capability-maturity approach to IAM deployments
  • Comfortable with subjects such as TCP/IP networking, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Data Stores
  • Experience with Java/JavaScript/Groovy, HTML/CSS to support web application development
  • Experience in effort estimates and sizing of projects
  • Self-motivated, willing to take initiative, organized, able to work unaccompanied, and manage communications appropriately
  • Bachelor of Science in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Information Systems) or equivalent work-related level of experience
  • Availability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Outstanding cross-functional cooperation skills in particular with our Go-To-Market units.
  • Excellent communication, both verbal and written
  • Practical experience integrating IAM platforms with enterprise directories, applications, APIs, and identity systems, including federation, authentication, and user lifecycle or provisioning flows.
  • Experience with identity standards and protocols such as SCIM, HTTP/REST APIs, and common directory and federation patterns, in addition to OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, FIDO and LDAP.
  • Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations.
  • Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues.
  • Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations.
  • Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes.
  • Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement.

You have an advantage if:

  • Computer and Software Security certifications
  • ForgeRock or Ping training badges/certifications
  • Skills with DevOps best practices, including deployment automation tools, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Ping Identity products and architectures, such as PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, PingOne, or PingID.
  • Experience with identity governance, privileged access, customer identity, or workforce identity use cases beyond a single IAM product or deployment pattern.
  • Familiarity with observability and operational tooling, such as centralised logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing.
  • Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments.
  • Experience migrating identity services, applications, or user populations from legacy platforms to modern IAM architectures.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | UK | Remote
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager | UK | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 91,755 - GBP 110,106. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer (all genders)

About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments.

This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data.

You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it.

What you will do

AI Ownership

  • Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction.

  • Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain.

  • Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline.

  • Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.

LLM Systems in Production

  • Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec.

  • Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review.

  • Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it.

  • Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.

Agent & Context Engineering

  • Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation.

  • Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability.

  • Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention.

  • Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code.

Reliability & Systems Thinking

  • Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early.

  • Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness.

  • Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought.

What we are looking for

  • Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks.

  • LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production.

  • Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not just vibes.

  • Python depth: You’re fluent in Python and comfortable in production service codebases. You make deliberate calls about async, framework choice, and performance.

  • Reliability instinct: Hallucination containment, idempotency on tool calls, graceful degradation when a model is wrong - part of how you design, not patched in later.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’re comfortable being the person who holds the full agent picture - from prompt to production incident. You identify what’s broken or missing before you’re asked.

  • A real spike: We’re a strong team with broad coverage. What we’re hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we’re currently underinvested in. That might be agent evaluation, context engineering on enterprise data, agentic reliability, deep NLP/LLM internals, or domain-specific grounding. We don’t know exactly what shape it takes - but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

jobs.description:
Head of Change.org, Germany - (snr Communications Manager)

Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org, Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle.

We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role.

Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions.

What you will achieve

  • Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events.

  • Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win.

  • Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works.

  • Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers.

  • Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in Germany on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations.

  • Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team.

  • Lead with AI. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter.

What you bring

  • A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks.

  • Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.

  • A strong network. You have trusted relationships with German journalists, editors and producers (ideally including key decision makers), and connections in politics and civil society across the whole democratic political spectrum, including conservative circles. You can use your contacts to place stories.

  • Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You set priorities, give direct feedback and bring out the best in people. At a Senior Manager level, you would move resources as the news and priorities shift.

  • Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are an experienced, media-trained spokesperson on live TV and radio and in front of senior stakeholders, and you handle tough interviews, crisis moments and politically sensitive questions with ease.

  • AI First: You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along.

Target experience

  • 5-8+ years in communications, campaigning, political communications, a newsroom or an agency.

  • 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team.

  • A proven track record of national campaigns in Germany that created significant public attention and media coverage.

  • Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or print media.

  • Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work.

  • Native-level German (C2) and professional English.

Interested? Great! Here's what you should know

This role is based in Berlin. It is a full-time hybrid role, and we expect you to be in the Berlin office 2-3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the rest of the week.

Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is €95,500 in Berlin. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in Berlin is €83,500.

We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. Change.org is an open platform designed to serve people across the full range of viewpoints. Effectively supporting that mission requires teams with a wide variety of experiences, skills and perspectives, which we consider essential to our work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected by law.

We're committed to protecting your data. To learn more, please review our Change.org Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know.

Professional-level English proficiency is required for all roles. While we are a global company, we ask that all CVs and application responses be submitted in English.

Senior People Operations Manager

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

 
 

The Role

You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat.

You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval.

What You'll Do

  • Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month

  • Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers.

  • Manage commission review, approvals, exceptions, ns and payment accuracy each cycle; reconcile commission data between sales systems, Finance, and payroll

  • Own equity grant administration: approvals, documentation, vesting schedules, leaver events, exercises, cap table reconciliation and employee communications

  • Build and improve people workflows in Humans, Ashby and connected systems, using automation to remove manual steps from pay reviews, promotion packs, onboarding and routine queries.

  • Own onboarding, probation, employment changes, transfers, parental leave, and offboarding end-to-end: coordinate access, equipment, payroll and documentation across People, IT, Finance and hiring managers

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR generalist experience in a scaling technology business or high-growth scaleup, with meaningful hands-on work in payroll, mobility, PEOs and benefits

  • Track record of building and running multi-country people processes from the ground up, not just maintaining existing structures.

  • Confidence owning payroll controls, global mobility operations and equity administration across multiple jurisdictions

  • Strong data literacy and experience with HRIS platforms, payroll systems and ATS integrations, with a bias toward automation over manual work

  • Clear written communicator who can produce clean documentation and audit-ready records

Valued

  • Experience independently owning multi-country payroll, mobility and equity through a scale up's growth phase.

  • Familiarity with PEO relationships, renewals and service management

How We Work

We're an office-first team in London. You'll be based at our offices on Paul Street and expect to work in-office as your default. We work together because it helps us move faster, collaborate closely across Finance, IT and People, and stay sharp on detail.

This role sits at the center of trust for the whole company. We expect high standards of accuracy, timeliness and data integrity. You'll manage sensitive information and ensure payments, visas, and equity records are handled properly.

People will come to you with urgent requests and competing priorities. You need to stay organised, keep control of your workload, and know when to push back and when to escalate. This isn't a role for someone who needs a heavy process or lots of direction.

 
 

Why Wordsmith

We're scaling fast across product, commercial, and engineering, and People operations is foundational to that growth. Every new hire adds complexity to payroll, visas, benefits, and equity. Getting that right, automated, ed and audit-ready is what lets us move quickly without losing control.

This role is a key foundational hire. You'll be building the systems and processes that scale with us from ~130 people toward 300. You'll have real ownership over how the function works, and a clear seat in how we operate.

You'll report to our Head of People (or interim People leader, with a clear line to a future Head of People), work closely with Finance and leadership, and have meaningful say in how we run the function.

Senior software engineer (Node.js/TypeScript)

Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 min intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager

  • Bar raiser - 40 min with two Engineering leaders focused on Engineering culture alignment

  • Technical loop - 2h virtual technical assessment with 2 core components - system design, TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!
