jobs.description:
Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)

Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research


About Panteia

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies  (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations.  Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States.

Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments.

 

As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence.

 

The role

To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.

This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional  standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

 

Key responsibilities

Project delivery & leadership

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements.

  • Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

 

Team & quality leadership

  • Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

  • Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

 

Role in acquisition & transition

The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

  • Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals.

  • Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage.

  • Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

 

Position in the organisation

  • Reports to: Team manager.

  • Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners.

  • Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility.

 

Practicalities

  • Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model
    – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week)
    – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations.

  • Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks.

 

Why join Panteia?

  • Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience.

  • Combine analytical depth with real policy impact.

  • Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets.

  • Work in a compact, expert-driven team.

  • Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered.

  • Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials.

  • Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc.


What Panteia is looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting.

  • Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis.

  • Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills.

  • Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes.

  • Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus.

  • MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field.

  • Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

 

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

 

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

 

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

 

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

 

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

·       Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

·       Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

·       Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools;

·       Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market;

·       Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes;

·       Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey;

·       Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities;

·       Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business;

·       Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working.


Who you are

You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and building trusted relationships with hiring managers.

You are proactive, curious and not afraid to challenge the business when you believe there is a better way to attract or select talent.

 

For this role, we are looking for someone who:

·       Has 3–5 years of experience in corporate recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within a product, technology or international organization;

·       Has experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to selection and offer;

·       Is confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and proactive sourcing techniques;

·       Has experience working closely with hiring managers and other business stakeholders;

·       Understands the importance of candidate experience and employer branding;

·       Is independent, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic environment;

·       Has a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys making recruitment processes better;

·       Communicates fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken;

·       Lives within reasonable commuting distance of De Lier, the Netherlands.


What you get   
In numbers 

·       A monthly salary between €3.600,00 - €5.100,00 based on your experience; 

·       We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

·       8% holiday allowance; 

·       Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

·       Be secured with our pension plan; 

·       Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

·       Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

·       Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

 

Ready to help us find the people behind our future?

If recruitment is more than filling vacancies to you, and you enjoy combining sourcing, stakeholder management and candidate experience, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and discover how you can help us create a climate for growth.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform

At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

  • Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

  • You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

  • You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week  

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

  • A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

  • Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

  • Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

  • A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.  

🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)  

🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.  

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself  

🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy  

🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

jobs.title: Legal AI Growth Manager
jobs.description:
Legal AI Growth Manager

Saga is a legal innovation company on a mission to remove the friction between legal expertise and real-world impact, so lawyers can focus on what matters the most: people, ethics, and impact. Founded in Norway and built for the legal profession from day one, we integrate with local legal sources across multiple jurisdictions and are currently available in 12 languages. In just 18 months, we've grown to 80+ employees and 5,000+ users across 20+ countries - with market leadership in Norway and The Netherlands, and active expansion across Europe. We believe technology shouldn't replace legal reasoning, but strengthen it - so the law can work as it's meant to: aligned, accountable, and capable of delivering justice for everyone.

As we grow, we're looking for someone at an unusual and valuable intersection: a legal professional ready to step into thought leadership, marketing, growth, and technology - and help us speak credibly to legal professionals while opening doors into the communities where they already gather.

Your role as a Legal AI Growth Manager

Building trust in the legal profession starts with understanding the people behind it. That's why we're looking for a legal professional who can help Saga build meaningful relationships, strengthen our presence in the Dutch legal market and connect with the communities where legal professionals exchange ideas and knowledge.

As Saga's first Legal AI Growth Manager, you'll join the Marketing & Growth team and work closely with Legal Engineering, Sales and Product. This role is an opportunity for a jurist, paralegal, legal counsel or lawyer who's curious about taking their career beyond traditional legal practice, bringing their legal expertise and professional network into the world of technology, marketing and growth.

This is a new role with room to shape it. You'll have the freedom to explore ideas, build initiatives from the ground up and develop approaches that can grow with Saga.


What you'll be doing

  • Build relationships and partnerships with lawyers, law firms, bar associations, alumni networks and legal innovators across the Netherlands.

  • Create thought leadership and educational content, translating legal insights and practical AI use cases into relevant articles, interviews and campaigns.

  • Grow the legal community through roundtables, workshops, webinars and networking initiatives.

  • Represent Saga at legal events and conferences, building connections and identifying new opportunities.

  • Bring market insights and customer feedback into Marketing, Product and Legal Engineering.

  • Support go-to-market and product marketing, working with Sales and Marketing to communicate Saga's value to legal professionals.

  • Develop advocacy initiatives that turn engaged customers and community members into long-term champions of Saga.

What you'll bring

  • A legal education and professional experience as a lawyer, jurist, legal counsel, paralegal or in a similar role.

  • Familiarity with the Dutch legal market and connections through professional associations, networks or industry events.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make legal and technical topics clear and engaging.

  • A natural ability to connect people, build relationships and create opportunities

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, curiosity and confidence to take initiative.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and an interest in how they're changing legal practice.

  • Native or near-native Dutch and fluent English.

Our team & culture

We're a team of lawyers, engineers, designers, and builders across multiple countries, with a startup mindset - flexible, fast-moving, and focused on what matters. We don't believe in rigid structures or unnecessary processes, but we do believe in discipline: showing up consistently, following through, and holding ourselves to a high standard.

Outside of work, many of us are active in sports - running, skiing, hiking - not as a mandate, but because we're drawn to the same mindset sport builds: consistency, resilience, and a long-term view. If you thrive in a flat, high-ownership environment, you'll feel right at home.

Why join Saga

Take your legal career in a new direction, without leaving your expertise behind.

You'll join an international team of lawyers, engineers, builders, and commercial professionals working to make legal AI genuinely useful and accessible. We keep structures light, encourage ownership and give people room to experiment, learn and make an impact.

Senior Manager, New Business DACH & Benelux

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH & Benelux.

About the job

This position is needed to lead one of our New Business Account Executive teams selling into DACH & Benelux within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South & DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced sales leader who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution-selling Account Executives disciplined in driving new logo acquisition and expanding market presence.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build and manage a high performing team of account executives focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and driving new logo growth.
  • Coach and lead a team to identify and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.
  • Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.
  • Work closely with our Marketing, Professional Services & Partner teams to build a robust pipeline and accelerate time-to-value for new prospects.
  • Forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company.
  • Experience in building teams, driving pipeline creation, managing monthly forecasting, supporting fiscal planning, and tracking revenue for new business accounts.
  • Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries.
  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.
  • Industry experience in selling CPaaS or SaaS and managing complex sales negotiations.
  • Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.
  • A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent required.
  • Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence.
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.
  • Fluent in German or Dutch

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Ireland | Remote
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Ireland | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Bonus Points For:

  • Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
  • Experience working with OSS communities
  • Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
  • Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is €104,000 - €124,800. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

YipitData’s Corporate team collaborates directly with organizations like Summer Fridays, 3M, and Uber to build one of the most comprehensive views into how consumers in the U.S. are purchasing and engaging with brands. By transforming massive volumes of consumer data into accurate, reliable, and actionable insights, we enable our clients to understand not just what is happening in their businesses, but why—and to use that understanding to make higher-confidence decisions in an increasingly competitive landscape.

Over the years, we’ve delivered high-impact insights across core retail sectors, and our clients have found this data so valuable that demand has expanded into new sectors.To meet this growing demand, we are expanding our Data team within the Corporate practice and are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead our new sectors. This role is a unique opportunity to shape how YipitData enters and scales coverage in entirely new verticals.

The Sectors Data team is responsible for taking YipitData’s core retail metrics and making them usable and reliable in new verticals—through improved category classification, more precise product attribution, and continuously increasing data accuracy as coverage evolves.You will work closely with our Insights team to understand what clients in new sectors truly need, then rapidly and iteratively transform the data to deliver those insights You’ll play a critical role in building the methodologies, workflows, and quality standards that allow these sectors to scale.

You’ll report to the Head of Data and operate as a player-coach, balancing hands-on analytical ownership with responsibility for setting standards, improving workflows, collaborating with cross-stakeholders, and coaching analysts on your team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in ambiguity & rapid growth, enjoys building systems from the ground up, and wants to shape how new sectors are operationalized at scale.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarter is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Miami, Mountain View, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Emerging Sectors Data Lead, You Will:

  • Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of client deliverables within new sectors, driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency, and partnering closely with product and revenue leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert for emerging sector data, partnering with GTM teams on client conversations to explain methodologies, address questions, and ensure our data solutions align with client needs
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues, proactively troubleshooting client- or internal QA concerns, and implementing scalable fixes
  • Design, standardize, and maintain scalable workflows, ensuring consistency and efficiency as coverage expands
  • Own and evolve sector categorization frameworks, including maintaining and enhancing core sector taxonomies and building custom categorizations for sector-specific clients
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while mentoring and empowering your team to do their best work
  • Partner cross-functionally with other teams including Data, Insights, Revenue, and Engineering to uncover and execute on opportunities to further drive ARR growth and optimize our processes and pipelines

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in data analytics, data operations, or consulting, including 2+ years in a lead or management capacity
  • You have 4+ years of experience working with SQL, Python, Pyspark, or other programming languages to explore and transform large, complex datasets; Familiarity with Github and Databricks
  • You have strong experience working with large, messy, evolving datasets, especially in environments with changing definitions or taxonomies
  • You are comfortable with SQL and Python (or similar tools) and have experience building and maintaining production-grade data workflows (Databricks, Spark, GitHub familiarity a plus)
  • You have a strong ownership mindset and enjoy building structure in fast-moving environments
  • You have strong communication skills and are able to work and project manage effectively with stakeholders across both technical and non-technical teams

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • The annual on-target earnings for this position is anticipated to be up to $170K ~ $190K + 10% target variable. The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks.
  • The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, and Mountain View. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Onboarding Manager

Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du bekommst jede Woche neue Kunden zugewiesen, die sich nicht selbst aktiviert haben, und führst sie durch das Onboarding: Erstkontakt innerhalb weniger Tage, Onboarding-Call per Screenshare, Profil und Suchprofil einrichten, erste Angebote begleiten. Rund 40 Onboardings im Monat, jedes etwa anderthalb Stunden Gesamtaufwand inklusive Vorbereitung und Nachfassen.

Du misst dich nicht am abgehaltenen Call, sondern am Kunden, der danach selbst weitermacht. Dafür verfolgst du die Aktivierungssignale jedes Kunden in Salesforce und greifst nach, wo einer hängen bleibt.

Du bist die Person im Unternehmen, die am häufigsten sieht, wo Neukunden scheitern. Dieses Wissen gibst du strukturiert an Product weiter, damit Tool Tips, Product Tours und Hilfetexte besser werden und mehr Kunden sich selbst aktivieren.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success und arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team, das die Kunden abschließt, und mit den Customer Success Managern, die bei Kündigungen übernehmen.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Mindestens 90 % deiner Kunden sind 30 Tage nach dem Onboarding aktiv – Profil vollständig, Suchprofil eingerichtet, erstes Angebot abgegeben.

  • Jeder zugewiesene Kunde hat innerhalb von drei Werktagen von dir gehört.

  • Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Onboarding-Status, Aktivierungssignale, Hürden – bei jedem Kunden.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Wenn ein Kunde nach 30 Tagen nicht aktiv ist, fragst du zuerst, was du anders hättest machen können.

  • Speed. Du rufst heute an, nicht nächste Woche. Ein Kunde, der drei Wochen wartet, hat Cosuno vergessen.

  • Drive. Du hast schon einmal ein Skript, eine Checkliste oder einen Ablauf gebaut, weil der alte nicht funktioniert hat – ohne dass dich jemand gebeten hat.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und dabei merkst, wann dein Gegenüber wirklich verstanden hat – und wann es nur nickt.

  • du 40 Gespräche im Monat als Rhythmus empfindest, nicht als Last.

  • du nach dem dritten Nichterreichen zum vierten Mal anrufst, zu einer anderen Uhrzeit – unsere Kunden stehen auf der Baustelle.

  • du Handwerksbetriebe magst und mit einem Dachdecker genauso sprichst wie mit einer Büroleitung.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als Schulung verstehst und nach dem Call abhakst.

  • du Tickets abarbeiten willst statt Kunden hinterherzutelefonieren

  • du zehn Kunden intensiv betreuen möchtest statt vierzig in die Nutzung zu bringen.

  • dich eine Zahl über deinem Schreibtisch stresst statt motiviert.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr in einer kundennahen Rolle mit Volumen: Onboarding, Customer Support mit Aktivierungsziel, Inside Sales, Kundenservice im B2B.

  • Sicher im Erklären von Software per Telefon und Screenshare.

  • Strukturiert und CRM-diszipliniert.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch gut.

  • Berlin oder Bereitschaft zu Bürotagen.

Vergütung

55.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Eine Zahl, ein Playbook, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis – und auf das Produkt.

  • Entwicklung: Die Rolle ist der Einstieg in Customer Success bei Cosuno; der nächste Schritt ist Retention Sales oder Produkt-Enablement.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin-Kreuzberg oder hybrid, du wählst.

  • Team: Regelmäßige 1:1s, offene Feedbackkultur, Firmen- und Teamevents.

Compensation: €50K – €55K • 55.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

Senior QA Engineer (m/f/d)

Your mission

  • Analyse requirements and user stories and identify gaps, edge cases, and risks early in the development process
  • Design and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, checklists, and requirement traceability
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, end-to-end, and acceptance testing
  • Test complex role- and permission-based scenarios, including multiple user roles, restricted access, and cross-board visibility
  • Verify end-to-end integrations with Microsoft 365
  • Test our iOS and Android applications across different devices and operating systems
  • Validate configuration settings as well as data import and export functionality
  • Report clear and reproducible defects and actively support their resolution
  • Participate in release readiness, smoke testing, and post-release verification
  • Use AI tools to improve test analysis, test design, debugging, and investigation

Your profile

QA expertise

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Software QA
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and shift-left testing practices
  • Solid knowledge of functional, regression, smoke, integration, E2E, exploratory, UAT, compatibility, usability, and localization testing
  • Experience with test design techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transitions, pairwise testing, and scenario-based testing
  • Experience working with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  • Strong experience testing complex permission models and RBAC scenarios
  • Experience with workflow-heavy products, such as approval processes, deadlines, or publishing rules
  • Strong root-cause analysis skills using browser DevTools, network requests, console logs, local storage, REST and GraphQL payloads

Microsoft 365

  • Hands-on experience testing applications integrated with Microsoft 365, such as SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, or Entra ID

Mobile & API testing

  • Proven experience testing mobile applications on iOS and Android
  • Understanding of mobile-specific risks such as device and OS fragmentation, permissions, network connectivity, push notifications, deep links, and app updates
  • Experience working with TestFlight, Android test builds, and device logs
  • Hands-on experience testing GraphQL APIs, including queries, mutations, variables, fragments, and schema introspection
  • Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, authentication, authorisation, validation, error handling, and status codes
  • Ability to validate data consistency between API and UI

AI tools

  • Practical experience using AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or GitHub Copilot in QA workflows
  • Experience using AI for requirements analysis, test case generation, log investigation, payload analysis, or test automation support
  • Good understanding of AI limitations and responsible handling of sensitive data

Other

  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Experience with test automation using C# / .NET, Playwright, or xUnit
  • Knowledge of access-control security testing, including OWASP Top 10, IDOR, and privilege escalation
  • Experience in Enterprise B2B SaaS or governance / compliance software
  • ISTQB certification

Why us?

  • A key role with direct impact on the quality and reliability of our product
  • The opportunity to shape QA standards, processes, and testing strategies
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering
  • A modern tech environment with complex and meaningful testing challenges
  • 100% remote work with a high level of ownership and flexibility
  • An international and ambitious team with an open feedback culture
  • Regular team offsites and opportunities for professional development

Head of Creative

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Own creative direction for Allica Bank across brand, design, motion, video, copy and web, leading a multi-disciplinary studio team that serves both brand & marketing work and the high-volume production needs of Growth & Digital Acquisition. Balance hands-on craft leadership with production efficiency at scale, and drive AI adoption across the studio to meet growth's velocity requirements without compromising brand or compliance standards.

Principal Accountabilities

Creative direction & craft

  • Set and maintain creative direction across all brand & growth touchpoints including digital, video, motion, print/OOH, email, sales collateral and internal comms.

  • Provide hands-on creative direction and craft feedback across brand, copy, design, motion and video.

  • Direct and prioritise in-house studio output; own the AI tooling roadmap for extending capacity and make the resourcing case if/when AI-assisted tools no longer cover demand.

Team & production management

  • Lead, develop and manage a team of 7 across copy, design, motion/video and web.

  • Own production process end-to-end: briefing, resourcing, review cycles, delivery timelines, quality control.

  • Manage external agency/freelance relationships where in-house capacity is stretched.

Production capacity & growth support

  • Own the studio's operating model for serving two distinct demand types: considered brand/campaign work, and high-volume, fast-turnaround performance/growth creative (landing pages, ad variants, paid social, CRO test assets).

  • Build a production process (templating, design systems, copy/creative frameworks, AI-assisted variant generation) that can meet Growth & Digital Acquisition's volume and speed requirements without pulling the whole studio into reactive, always-on production.

  • Partner directly with Growth/Digital Acquisition leadership to support in-housing of all Allica’s creative assets, agree SLAs, prioritisation rules, and what can be templated/self-served vs. what needs bespoke creative input.

  • Decide what volume of production can be safely delegated to AI-assisted workflows versus what requires human craft and compliance review.

  • Track studio capacity against demand from both brand and growth, and use that data to make resourcing/tooling cases.

AI adoption

  • Own the studio's broader AI adoption roadmap across design, copy, motion and web production, balancing speed against brand quality and IP/copyright risk.

  • Periodically reassess whether AI tooling is sufficient to cover demand or whether the team has outgrown that setup, and make a resourcing case if so.

Brand

  • Champion brand consistency and evolution as Allica scale.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Proven creative leadership role (Creative Lead/Director level) in a high-growth in-house or prestigious agency environment, managing a multi-discipline team of similar size.

  • Genuine hands on craft experience across brand, copy, design and motion/video, not delegated oversight.

  • Practical, current experience embedding AI tools into creative production workflows (design, copy, motion, and ideally web/no-code tooling).

  • Experience running a creative studio that serves both brand and performance/growth marketing demand, understands the difference in process, pace and quality bar between the two.

  • Experience building templated/systemised creative production (design systems, modular copy frameworks, creative testing pipelines) to support high-volume output.

  • • Comfortable partnering with Growth, Digital Acquisition and Product stakeholders, not just Brand and Marketing.

  • Strong commercial acumen and able to work with senior commercial, product and growth leads and advocate for the importance of quality creative execution.

  • Financial promotions or regulated marketing experience: a plus, not a requirement. Comfortable learning and operating within a regulated approval process even without prior direct experience.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Life assurance

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist

The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist focuses on supporting all Distalmotion entities on driving strategic management decisions through financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting. The role works closely with FP&A Leadership and is cross-functional with the teams’ stakeholders to track performance, analyze variances, develop financial outlooks, and support key business initiatives.

The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist has the capacity to operate autonomously and maintain a high standard of accuracy and consistency in financial outputs and supports ongoing improvements to FP&A processes and reporting.

TASKS:

Financial Planning:

• Support the development of Distalmotion’s short-, medium-, and long-term financial plans by preparing analyses, models, and inputs that align with corporate objectives

• Assist in the annual budgeting, rolling forecast, and long-range planning processes by collecting inputs from departments, validating assumptions, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency

• Build, maintain, and update financial and forecasting models under guidance from FP&A Leadership, including scenario and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making

• Support the preparation and financial evaluation of business cases for new investments and strategic initiatives, including analysis of costs, benefits, and key risks

• Prepare financial analyses and summaries that provide management with forward-looking insights on performance, profitability, and resource allocation

Financial Analysis & Performance Management:

• Support month and quarterly performance reviews by preparing standard reports, ad hoc analyses, and management presentations ensuring accuracy within communicated timelines

• Support FP&A Leadership in the preparation of budgets and forecasts by completing analysis that is presented accurately and timely

• Develop ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decision making

• Perform financial and operational performance analysis across functions, programs, and projects, supporting management’s understanding of business results

• Prepare and maintain KPI reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to provide clear visibility into actuals versus budget and forecast

• Analyze variances and key performance drivers, clearly explaining results, risks, and opportunities

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders

• Review historical budgets, expenditures, and forecasts to identify trends and opportunities to improve planning and forecasting accuracy

• Provide meaningful insights by challenging business assumptions and educating business partners on financial issues and concepts

• Contribute to competitor, market, and industry analyses by gathering data and assessing financial implications to support strategic planning

Requirements

Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting, Master’s degree preferred

• Minimum of 7 years of progressive FP&A experience, in a medical device company

• Knowledge of US GAAP financial reporting requirements

• Proven expertise in financial modelling, accounting, forecasting, and variance analysis skills

• Experience working in multinational organization and collaborating with global finance teams

Skills & Competencies :

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong business acumen and understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow dynamics

• Experience with cross functional business partnering in a medical device company

• Good interpersonal skills and proven track record of working independently and adapting quickly in a dynamic, evolving environment

• Established proficiency with inventory management and margin improvement initiatives

• Result & performance driven: assumes full ownership and accountability for delivering accurate and timely results while seeking guidance only when needed

• Able to translate FP&A Leadership instructions and requests into meaningful output within required timelines

• Demonstrated ability to work multiple projects and priorities simultaneously under time pressure while keeping high level of quality and accuracy

• Sense of urgency: ability to identify, prioritize, and execute work/project plans

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential information

• Proven track record of developing and maintaining cash forecasting models to support cash flow scenario analysis within a complex accounting structure in a global organization

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cultures and organizational levels, and to build trusted, culturally sensitive partnerships in a global environment

• Willingness to adjust work schedule to ensure time sensitive deliverable commitments are achieved

• Fluent in English

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

jobs.description:
SAP Analytics Consultant

We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Wat ga je doen?

Als werkstudent binnen Fulfilment ondersteun je verschillende teams en werk je mee aan projecten. Je gaat de ene keer aan de slag binnen één specifieke afdeling, en de andere keer ga je meewerken aan projecten die meerdere afdelingen raken. Fulfilment bestaat uit de afdelingen Production, Logistics & Warehousing, Supplier Quality Engineering en Procurement & Planning.

Afhankelijk van het project houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Ondersteunen van collega's bij operationele en administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Meewerken aan lopende projecten binnen de verschillende Fulfilment-afdelingen;

  • Verzamelen, analyseren en verwerken van data;

  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en meedenken over efficiëntere processen;

  • Zelfstandig oppakken en uitvoeren van (LEAN-)deelprojecten.

  • Zo doe je naast je studie waardevolle praktijkervaring op en krijg je de mogelijkheid om jouw kennis direct toe te passen binnen een professionele werkomgeving.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wie ben jij?

Wij zoeken een enthousiaste student die graag kennismaakt met de praktijk en initiatief durft te nemen.

Daarnaast:

  • Volg je een HBO- of WO-opleiding in een bedrijfseconomische en/of logistieke richting;

  • Ben je 16 tot 24 uur per week beschikbaar, in overleg;

  • Werk je analytisch en nauwkeurig;

  • Beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

Naast een interessante bijbaan waarin je relevante werkervaring opdoet, bieden we je:

Over Eye

Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies

  • Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands

  • Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben

  • Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde

  • Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek

  • Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten

  • Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen

De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels

  • Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn

  • Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel

  • Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen

Mooi meegenomen

  • Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden

  • Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS

Wat krijg je?

  • Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert

  • Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter

  • Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken

  • Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation"

Over Eye Security

Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden.

We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers.

Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO

Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO). Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie.

Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.

Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming.

  • Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie.

  • Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken.

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan.

  • Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen.

  • Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's).

  • Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming.

  • Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.


Wat vragen wij?
