Senior Account Executive

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

We are one of Inc’s Best Workplaces - a fast-growing technology company with offices located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, backed by Norwest Venture Partners and The Carlyle Group with a strong culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

About The Role (and Challenges You’ll Be Helping To Solve!):

We are looking to add an experienced Senior Account Executive to our Corporate team who will act as a main growth driver across a portfolio of existing clients within our corporate sector. The goal is to position YipitData's must-have products and ensure renewals with a disproportionate focus on account growth.

The Senior Account Executive will own the commercial relationship for existing business, be responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities, having a relationship with every budget owner and decision maker, and owning the renewal. You will be responsible for creating advocates for our products and assisting them find answers to their key questions by collaborating closely with our research, data product, and client strategy teams to provide a "must have" service to our clients.

This remote-friendly opportunity can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, or Seattle), or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. Please note that we pay NYC-based salaries for US roles regardless of where employees choose to work.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have at least 6+ years of experience in subscription and/or research sales in a fast-paces environment
  • You have experience selling insights to retailers
  • You have experience managing the holistic life cycle of a client relationship from onboarding, quarterly business reviews, renewal, and upsells
  • You have experience selling into large enterprises, negotiating contracts with sophisticated procurement teams, and liaising with senior executives across several business functions such as strategy, sales, marketing, and data/analytics
  • You have experience managing a book of business and or selling a new complex product or service
  • You have a track record of not only meeting, but exceeding sales goals
  • You are a team player and are motivated by the company’s success, not just your own
  • You are excited about the integration of data into strategic decision-making
  • With a high EQ, you are sensitive to clients’ needs and quickly develop client relationships
  • You are resourceful, resilient, and have strong oral and written communication - including great questioning - skills
  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit and are excited to help build a newer business from the ground up
  • You love solving ambiguous problems and are willing to persevere through the highs and lows of creating something new

Meet Your Team:

  • Check out this video to learn why our Corporate team members love being part of YipitData!

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits and perks, equity, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, unlimited vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, a wellness and work-from-home budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to self-improve and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • The annual on-target earnings ($140-150K base salary + variable commission earned at 100% of quota) for the Senior Executive position is anticipated to be up to $270,000. The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks. The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, and Seattle. If the remote work is performed outside these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

jobs.description:
Content Creator in Residence (Intern)

Baue eine Marke von Anfang an. Mit guten Ideen – und einem Plan dahinter.

Fortisana ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink für Menschen ab 40, die aktiv bleiben wollen. Das Produkt steht. Wie wir daraus eine unverwechselbare Marke machen, gestalten wir jetzt. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Hinter Fortisana stehen Piran, Leon und Max:

  • Piran hat KoRo mitgegründet und über neun Jahre zu einer der erfolgreichsten Lebensmittelmarken Deutschlands aufgebaut.

  • Leon ist Ernährungsberater und in der Welt der Nahrungsergänzung aufgewachsen. Seine Familie produziert seit über 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel in Deutschland.

  • Max hat bereits mehr als sechs Startups begleitet und zuletzt bei 1KOMMA5° gelernt, wie aus einer Vision ein operativ exzellentes Unternehmen wird.

Du gibst Fortisana auf Social Media Haltung, Sprache und einen eigenen Stil. Und du findest heraus, welche Botschaften bei welchen Menschen wirklich ankommen.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Inhalte. Aus unserer Positionierung entwickelst du Botschaften, Tonalität und Formate für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kaufmotive.

  • Du stellst gute Fragen und testest deine Antworten. Du formulierst Hypothesen, entwickelst passende Inhalte und legst fest, woran wir ihren Erfolg erkennen.

  • Du setzt selbst um. Du schreibst Texte und produzierst Kurzvideos, Stories und Bildserien – von der ersten Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung.

  • Du lernst aus Zahlen. Du wertest Ergebnisse aus, ziehst Schlüsse und priorisierst die nächsten Tests.

  • Du hörst zu. Fragen und Rückmeldungen aus der Community bringst du ins Team zurück, damit wir Marke und Angebot weiterentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du denkst in Zielgruppen und Wirkung. Du kannst erklären, wen ein Inhalt erreichen soll und warum du ihn genau so umsetzt.

  • Du hast schon etwas ausprobiert. Zeig uns einen Kanal, eine Kampagne, ein Hochschulprojekt oder ein eigenes Projekt. Entscheidend ist, was du gemacht und gelernt hast.

  • Du verbindest Kreativität mit Analyse. Du liest Zahlen und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher. Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du formulierst in beiden Sprachen sicher, präzise und zielgruppengerecht.

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit Gesundheitsthemen um. Du machst komplexe Inhalte verständlich, ohne sie zu übertreiben.

  • Du bist vor Ort. Du kannst sechs Monate in Vollzeit in Berlin mit uns arbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest AI-native und mit Qualitätsanspruch. Du testest eigenständig neue KI-Tools und kreative Ansätze und integrierst sie sinnvoll in deine Workflows. Dabei prüfst du die Ergebnisse kritisch und hältst unseren Qualitätsstandard bei Inhalt, Gestaltung und Genauigkeit hoch.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in Marketing, Markenaufbau oder Kommunikation sowie mit Video und Schnitt.

Was wir dir bieten

Du prägst mit, wie Fortisana aussieht, klingt und sich anfühlt. Dafür bekommst du kreativen Freiraum, Verantwortung und direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam. Der Markt ist voll. Wir wollen auffallen – mit guten Ideen und dem Mut, sie auszuprobieren.

In sechs Monaten entwickelst du deine Fähigkeiten in Markenstrategie, Storytelling und Produktion weiter und baust ein Portfolio auf, das deine Handschrift trägt. Nach einem erfolgreichen Praktikum besteht die Möglichkeit einer unbefristeten Vollzeitstelle mit Unternehmensbeteiligung.

Zeig uns deine Arbeit 🤎

Schick uns drei Arbeiten, auf die du stolz bist. Sag bei jeder Arbeit konkret, was von dir stammt: Idee, Skript, Dreh, Schnitt oder Veröffentlichung – und ob sie im Job, für einen Kunden oder als eigenes Projekt entstanden ist. Wenn vorhanden, ergänze Ergebnisse und was du daraus gelernt hast. Dazu brauchen wir deinen Standort, deinen möglichen Starttermin und ein kurzes Profil oder einen Lebenslauf.

  • Dein Kerngeschäft – Partnerbeziehungen: Du verantwortest mit Deinem Team die Beziehung zu unseren bestehenden Fachpartnern (SEM). Dazu gehören Bindung, Zufriedenheit, Umsatzentwicklung und der Ausbau der Partnerschaften. Der Bereich gliedert sich in zwei Segmente:
    • Kleinstpartner: Entwicklung automatisierter Prozesse, die eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit ohne großen individuellen Betreuungsaufwand ermöglichen.
    • Mittlere Partner: Automatisierung und Skalierung in Kombination mit persönlicher Betreuung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung zusammen und nimmst dadurch Einfluss auf unser Kerngeschäft sowie auf Innovationsthemen bei Aroundhome.
  • Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings, analysierst Erfolgskennzahlen von Partner:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen und leitest daraus eigenständig zielgerichtete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du führst ein achtköpfiges Team fachlich sowie disziplinarisch auf Basis klarer KPIs und entwickelst das Team zu Top-Performern weiter.

About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to build pipelines that turn raw exoskeleton recordings into clean, robot-ready training data, including retargeting human motion to the humanoid’s body. So in the future human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

  • Define signals, formats and metadata for our next exoskeleton generation

  • Build pipelines from devices in the field to storage, incl. sync, calibration and versioning

  • Implement anonymization, consent handling and GDPR-compliant data flows

  • Set up storage and compute together with our robot learning team

  • Strong Python and SQL; pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, Ray or Spark)

  • Time-series or multimodal sensor data, incl. synchronization and calibration

  • Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Linux

  • Solid understanding of GDPR and personal data

Nice to have

  • ROS 2, MCAP or LeRobot; annotation or dataset management tools

aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als

entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland.

Die Rolle

Als Head of Corporate Communications verantwortest du die Kommunikation eines Unternehmens in einer prägenden Phase: FASTR ist als bundesweiter, integrierter Energiedienstleister für die Immobilienwirtschaft, Kommunen und Stadtwerke neu aufgestellt und wächst.   • Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie des Unternehmens und führst interne wie externe Kommunikation zu einem konsistenten Auftritt zusammen.

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit von Corporate Communications und Sales Marketing und verantwortest die digitalen Marketingkampagnen – von Content über Social Media bis Performance Marketing – zur Unterstützung von Markenbekanntheit und Leadgenerierung.

  • Du schaffst die Grundlagen einer skalierbaren Kommunikationsfunktion: Prozesse, Guidelines, Standards und Strukturen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Du führst ein kleines Team an der Schnittstelle von Kommunikation und Marketing, entwickelst es weiter und verzahnst beide Bereiche eng.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Unternehmenskommunikation, davon nachweislich in einer gestaltenden oder aufbauenden Funktion.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung darin, eine neue oder sich entwickelnde Markenidentität kommunikativ zu tragen.

  • Nähe zu erklärungsbedürftigen Branchen wie Energie, Infrastruktur oder Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Erfahrung im Employer Branding und Personalmarketing, idealerweise in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Marketingkampagnen (z. B. Content-, Social-Media- und Performance-Marketing) sowie im Zusammenspiel mit Sales Marketing.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine Aufbau- und Gestaltungsrolle mit echtem Mandat statt vorgegebener Routinen.

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und Einfluss auf die Außen- und Innenwahrnehmung des Unternehmens.

  • Ein Unternehmen in einer aktiven Wachstums- und Integrationsphase, in der Kommunikation strategisch gebraucht wird.

jobs.title: Senior Partner
jobs.description:
Senior Partner

About the Role

A legal services and legal technology team is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice. You will bring an established client book, continue serving those clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI agent tools.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to the firm's growth and help shape its development.

  • Bring your portable client book to the practice and continue advising existing clients.

  • Build market relationships across private equity, venture capital, and mid-market businesses.

  • Identify opportunities to provide commercial and compliance services to clients and their portfolio companies.

  • Work with the founding team to identify recurring legal matters suitable for workflow automation.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience as a partner at a recognized law firm or boutique.

  • German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English.

  • A personally portable book of business worth at least €1 million, diversified across clients and not dependent on a large-firm brand.

  • Strong relationships with private equity or venture capital firms, mid-market companies, or portfolio businesses, and experience in recurring commercial, technology and data, corporate, venture capital, or regulatory work.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI software, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows to automation.

  • A feasible client transition within approximately six months, without restrictive terms that prevent client migration.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Meaningful equity is offered. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Based in Berlin, Germany. The role may be on-site or remote within Germany; in-person work in Berlin is preferred.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Solutions Engineer

About the Role

Join a technical pre-sales team helping industrial R&D organizations modernize research data management and accelerate product development. You will combine deep scientific expertise with value-based selling to guide enterprise prospects from initial demonstrations through technical evaluations and pilots.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical pre-sales process, from product demonstrations to value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots that reflect prospects' research and development workflows.

  • Partner with account executives and customer stakeholders to communicate business value and support new customer acquisition.

  • Lead technical evaluations and presentations that show how digital tools can improve R&D data management and innovation.

  • Mentor early-career team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write scripts and configure integrations when needed for customer engagements.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for prospect meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or R&D leadership.

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or materials science, preferably with a computational or machine learning focus.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and an understanding of enterprise R&D workflows and laboratory informatics.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based sales approach.

  • Professional experience supporting digital transformation or leading R&D initiatives in a chemical or materials organization; technical management consulting experience is also relevant.

  • Python scripting skills and the ability to configure platform integrations.

  • Fluent English and, for European locations, advanced proficiency in the local language. Must be authorized to work in the United States, United Kingdom, or Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available.

  • Willingness to travel 25% to 50% and to work from or relocate to Munich, London, or New York.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual base salary: $120,000 to $150,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid, based in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. London, United Kingdom, or New York, New York, may also be considered.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector (m/f/d) in the Aviation Industry
jobs.description:
Quality Inspector (m/f/d) in the Aviation Industry
Your mission

Thanks to you the plane can take off: Help make tomorrow’s aviation even more efficient and safer and play an active role in the quality inspection of aircraft components.
 
As part of an experienced and dynamic team you’ll be responsible for ensuring product quality and compliance with our customers’ quality standards. You have in-depth knowledge of quality control procedures and methods as well as the ability to conduct effective quality inspections and identify issues. 
With us you’ll shape the environment where you thrive—with work styles that suit you. You’ll remain flexible. And you’ll become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.
 
Here’s what you can expect:

  • Visual inspection of aircraft components
  • Preparation, analysis and documentation of non-conformities 
  • Creation, processing and tracking of non-conformity reports 
  • Evaluation of technical complaints 
  • Your responsibilities will include final inspection and certification of conformity, first-article inspection, functional testing and completion of the corresponding documentation.


Your profile

  • You have successfully completed a technical training program (Techniker/Meister; all genders) or a degree program (aircraft construction, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering or similar).
  • You already have at least 2 years of professional experience in aircraft manufacturing and have had exposure to the NC process.
  • You have knowledge of quality assurance.
  • You have very good English skills and basic knowledge of German is a plus. 
  • You will work on-site in Hamburg-Finkenwerder and are willing to work early and late shifts.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Senior Enterprise Account Executive

📍Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 Basic £70k, realistic £140k OTE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK.


As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite.


If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!


A bit about you…

  • You have 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales.

  • Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist SAP & ERP Specialist
jobs.description:
Deployment Strategist SAP & ERP Specialist

TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.

Description de l'entreprise

Tech Riders est un cabinet de conseil qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs enjeux SI en proposant des services d’excellence sur deux domaines essentiellement :

Nous croyons fermement que l'épanouissement professionnel est intimement lié à un équilibre sain entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle, une évolution de carrière fluide grâce à l'acquisition de nouvelles expertises, ainsi qu'une rémunération équitable.

Conscients des priorités et attentes de nos collaborateurs, nous nous engageons à construire une entreprise à taille humaine, fondée sur des valeurs et des principes solides tels que la cohésion d'équipe, la transparence, l'équilibre de vie, et le partage de connaissances et de prospérité.

Vos missions

IT Strategy / Définition et déclinaison de la stratégie IT

Au sein d'un environnement CIO Office, vous accompagnerez le management IT dans la définition, la structuration et la formalisation de sa stratégie IT.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :

  • Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie IT, en assurant son alignement avec les enjeux métiers, technologiques et les orientations du Groupe ;

  • Analyser l'existant (As-Is) et définir une vision cible (To-Be), en identifiant les axes de transformation et les opportunités d'optimisation ;

  • Structurer les piliers stratégiques IT et les décliner en initiatives, trajectoires de transformation et roadmaps ;

  • Conduire des analyses stratégiques transverses : architecture, Data & IA, cybersécurité, infrastructure, operating model, sourcing et delivery ;

  • Challenger les orientations techniques, fonctionnelles et organisationnelles des différentes parties prenantes ;

  • Préparer et animer des workshops stratégiques avec les responsables IT, les métiers et les experts ;

CIO Office / Communication exécutive & Gouvernance

  • Produire des synthèses exécutives et supports d'aide à la décision, facilitant les arbitrages du management ;

  • Contribuer au suivi de la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie IT.

Vos compétences

Outils et environnement

  • PowerPoint — maîtrise avancée indispensable : présentations exécutives, storytelling stratégique, visualisation de données et qualité graphique ;

  • Excel et Word : analyses, business cases et notes stratégiques ;

  • Outils collaboratifs : Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira ;

  • Bonne connaissance des frameworks IT Strategy, IT Governance, Target Operating Model (TOM) et IT Roadmap ;

  • Culture IT transverse : Cloud, Data & IA, cybersécurité, architecture SI, infrastructure et IT Operations.

Description du profil

Le profil recherché dispose idéalement des compétences suivantes :

Une expérience en cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou transformation IT constitue un véritable atout.

Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Senior Projectmanager

Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

jobs.title: Junior Public Sector Account Executive
Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Reliability Engineer

Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

  • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

  • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

  • Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.



How you make your mark.

  • Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

  • Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

  • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

  • Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

  • Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.



What you bring to the team.

  • Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

  • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

  • Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

  • Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

  • Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

  • Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.



What sets you apart.

  • Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

  • Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.

jobs.description:
Principal Engineer, Applied AI (Fullstack/Backend)

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role

AI is disrupting our stack from the inside, and we're looking for a Principal Engineer to architect that transformation from day one. Applied AI is a small, fast-moving team building a fresh take on how patient care should happen, from intake through ongoing care companionship. While much of the team is focused on research and rapid experimentation, this role is the productionization counterpart — the person who takes what's working and makes it robust, scalable, and reliable enough to run in production at the core of the patient experience.

You'll be the key architect of the patient-facing experience end-to-end, owning how the services across the stack fit together. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks about robustness, scalability, and debuggability from day one, and who can balance building for today with architecting for where the product needs to go over the next several years.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Service Architecture

    Own the overall architecture for the Applied AI stack — how individual services blend together into a coherent, end-to-end patient-facing experience, from intake through ongoing companion interactions.

  • Productionize AI-Driven Experiences

    Partner with research-focused teammates who move fast on experimentation, and take their work to production: hardening services for uptime, reliability, and scale. Bring engineering rigor to a team that's optimized for speed of iteration.

  • Reliability & Operational Excellence

    Instill best practices around debugging, observability, and operational readiness. Design for robustness and scalability from day one rather than retrofitting it later.

  • Mentorship & Talent Growth
    Mentor senior technical leaders, elevating engineering capabilities across the organization. Champion initiatives that foster talent density, engineering rigor, and a culture of continuous learning

  • Ambiguity Navigation & Execution Acceleration
    Lead through complexity and ambiguity, clarifying direction where ownership is unclear. Remove organizational blockers, simplify decision-making, and accelerate delivery of strategic initiatives

  • Customer-Centric Engineering
    Translate customer needs and product goals into scalable technical solutions. Define principles and patterns that embed customer obsession into our platform’s architecture

  • Sustainability & Scalability
    Design systems and team boundaries to support sustainable growth. Drive investment in non-functional priorities (e.g., observability, migrations, reliability) early in the design process

What You Bring

  • 15+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep architectural expertise and a record of delivering production systems at scale.

  • Proven track record of influencing technical strategy and delivering cross-org technical initiatives at the group or organizational level.

  • Excellent track record standing up services at scale in production, with a demonstrated ability to think about robustness, scalability, and debuggability from day one.

  • Deep experience owning service architecture across a full stack — understanding how services should blend together, not just how to build any one of them well.

  • A "productionization" mindset: comfortable being the counterweight to a fast-moving research/experimentation culture, focused on uptime and reliability.

  • Hands-on engineering ability; you want to stay close to the code and the architecture, not just the roadmap.

  • Some exposure to LLM/AI services — you don't need deep AI expertise, but you should have tested the waters with LLM or AI-powered systems in some capacity.

  • Ability to think long-term and build for the future, balancing near-term delivery with durable architecture.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across research, product, and clinical stakeholders.

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Create alignment and momentum in ambiguous or complex technical spaces.

  • Balance short-term deliverables with long-term scalability, system health, and customer experience.

  • Lead with curiosity, adaptability, and principled decision-making.

  • Take initiative to address cross-squad blockers, scale constraints, or misaligned priorities before they escalate.

  • Drive consistent, action-oriented execution even without perfect clarity.

  • Mentor senior engineering talent and reinforce a culture of growth, feedback, and high technical standards.

  • Inspire confidence through transparency, humility, and deep technical credibility.

  • Advocate for customers through scalable, resilient backend design that anticipates clinical complexity and future scale.

  • Want to help architect how AI reshapes a company's stack and product, from the inside, from day one.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Field Marketing Manager

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role Context

This role sits within Marketing, working alongside Sales and Product to make sure every trade show, conference, and webinar builds real pipeline, not just brand awareness. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Demand Generation and Field Marketing, and be one of the people on the ground making sure our presence at these events actually converts.

The Role

You'll own event execution end-to-end, from the first vendor call to the post-show report, for the trade shows, launches, and webinars that put MaintainX in front of the frontline-operations buyers who need us most.

  • Run full-cycle logistics for trade shows, conferences,from venue and vendor selection through on-site execution and teardown.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product to align every event around one goal: pipeline and revenue, not just attendance.

  • Manage event budgets and vendor relationships that keep quality high without letting costs creep.

  • Track performance against pipeline and engagement targets in Salesforce, Asana, and our reporting tools, and turn that data into recommendations for where we show up next.

  • Build and distribute event marketing materials that stay on-brand and on-message across every touchpoint.

You'll work closely with our sales and product marketing teams, and within your first 6-12 months you'll have a track record of events that reps, marketers, and leadership all point to as clearly worth the spend.

About You

Must-haves

  • 3+ years running trade shows, conferences, or field events, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

  • Ability to quantitatively report on pipeline attribution from events

  • Comfortable owning an event budget and managing multiple vendor and venue relationships at once

  • Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief stakeholders and run a room on-site

  • Organized enough to keep several events moving in parallel without dropping a detail

  • A data-driven approach - you track what worked, and you say so

  • Valid passport and the ability to travel roughly 30% of the time across the US and Canada

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with CMMS, industrial software, or another startup / entrepreneurial environment

We Offer

  • Work that shows up in the physical world. What you help launch and promote keeps factories, fleets, and facilities running better.

  • A product the industry already loves. You're building on something that already wins, with customers who renew and expand.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. Global reach and the resources of a public company, pointed at a problem we were already solving.

  • A career with real room. Operations is new ground inside Autodesk, and MaintainX is the biggest piece of it.

Values & How We Work
We reward output, not hours logged or hats worn. You'll get real ownership over how our events show up in the market, and the trust to make the call on the ground. We move fast, have honest conversations early, and expect the same back.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

  • Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

jobs.title: Staff Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Analytics Engineer

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in.

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational.

  • Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity.

  • Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.

  • Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.

  • Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.

  • Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.

  • Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.

  • Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.

What you bring

  • Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.

  • Deep BigQuery and SQL expertise, including performance, cost considerations, and the architectural challenges of complex analytical domains.

  • Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.

  • AI-native development practice in a data engineering context. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a genuine part of how you work, and you can be specific about where they add real value and where they introduce risk in a governed analytics codebase.

  • A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority.

  • Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime.

  • Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.

Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit if:

  • You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.

  • You genuinely enjoy growing a community of practice through influence rather than authority and you take pride in seeing colleagues adopt and grow standards.

  • You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

This role is not a good fit if

  • You want to own a domain. The Intelligence teams have strong AEs doing that. This role is for someone who wants to own the standards they build to.

  • You advise others to use AI coding tools but don't use them yourself. AI-native development is part of the mandate, not a differentiating nice-to-have.

  • You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have:

  • Mapped the current state of modelling standards and the semantic layer across the function (where definitions are consistent, where they diverge, and what the highest-impact gaps are) to draft a plan the function has bought into.

  • Contributed to the semantic layer tooling decision and begun onboarding the Analytics Engineers who'll build to it by writing documentation, running live sessions, reviewing PRs etc.

  • Established a visible presence in the AE community of practice and become someone whose feedback in code reviews and whose opinions on architecture are listened to because they've been demonstrated, not just stated.

  • Run your own workflow on AI coding tooling to the point where you can say clearly what the function should adopt, what it should not, and why.

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.

  5. Final interview: A 45-minutes interview with one of our senior leaders, focusing on assessing behavioural skills and values alignment.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This is a Staff level role at Pleo. This means it's a very senior position where you need to demonstrate experience leading technical initiatives that can have organisation-wide or cross-team impact for a tech business of 500-1000+ people. Prior experience owning a semantic layer is also a non-negotiable. Make sure your application reflects this.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Senior Software QA Engineer

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

You will build the platform that transforms raw neuro-signals into longitudinal patient insights, effectively defining the new standard of care in neuro-critical settings. As a Software Test Engineer for the CoVision project, you will be co-responsible for the safety and effectiveness of our medical devices through comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) processes. You will work throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), focusing on software and integration testing for both products and internal tools.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Compliance-as-Code: Build workflows that map verification evidence to regulatory standards and generate that evidence automatically.

  • Testing Strategy: Own comprehensive test plans, protocols and execution reports for medical device software.

  • V&V Leadership: Drive formal software verification and validation, ensuring adherence to IEC 62304 (Class C) and ISO 14971.

  • Process Automation: Push test automation, CI/CD pipelines and new testing techniques forward, including LLM-assisted quality gates.

  • Hardware Integration: Work with systems engineers to test multi-tasking systems and signal-processing applications on real hardware.

Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years in software testing, particularly for complex or safety-critical systems.

  • Proficiency in Python.

  • Experience in highly regulated industries, preferably medical device development.

  • Strong hands-on background in CI/CD, test automation, and build systems.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD).

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life insurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - West
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive - West

What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Senior Account Executive in the West region, you’ll report directly to the VP, Employer Sales - West.

The Senior Account Executive will deliver strong sales results within the West market in the 200-999 life segment. This role’s focus is relationship management within our partnership ecosystem of benefits brokers, consultants, general agents and employers. You will carry your own quota, activating new brokers, deepening the partners already producing for Garner, and opening the next wave of top-producing advisors. It is a build-and-close role: you fill your own pipeline, run deals end to end, and put in place the tracking that keeps your territory predictable. Every partner you activate puts higher-quality, lower-cost care in reach for more members.

What you will do

  • Own revenue responsibilities for your specific territory in the West market, which includes: CA, NV, AZ, UT, OR, ID, MT, HI, WA, AK
  • Continue and expand on Garner’s existing broker relationships
  • Develop foundational infrastructure and processes for tracking our sales and partnership pipeline

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a quota-carrying broker-channel sales role OR experience as a broker
  • A desire to work in a rapidly evolving startup environment with notable upside
  • A desire to be a part of our mission to improve the healthcare system
  • Experience selling benefits-adjacent products; healthcare experience is a plus but not required
  • Strong ability to present and communicate a value proposition to external stakeholders
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

What you’ll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation

The target total comp (inclusive of base + bonus) range for this role is $200,000 – $235,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description:
Art Director

About us

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing — the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on-brand, performance-tested campaigns in minutes — across every market, channel and language — without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.

Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows — connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems — so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision — you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

Reporting and partnerships

  • Reports to Juliette Suvitha, Head of AI Creative & Enablement.

  • Briefs and reviews daily output from the wider Creative team, providing hands-on guidance rather than formal management.

  • Works closely with Producers, the Creative Director, and Product teams to keep output strategically aligned and technically feasible.

  • Feeds back to Product on tools, workflows and user experience based on hands-on use.

Key responsibilities

Creative production

  • Design and deliver: creative assets across formats — advertising, digital and print — using GenAI tools.

  • Translate briefs into output: turn briefs into polished creative work that aligns with project objectives and the relevant visual identity.

  • Support flagship projects: contribute to creative production on projects that demonstrate Pencil’s product capabilities.

  • Juggle volume without dropping quality: manage multiple creative requests simultaneously, maintaining quality and consistency across deliverables.

Quality and client-facing work

  • Brief and review: brief the Creative team and review their daily output.

  • Own quality control: provide daily quality checks on client decks and feedback.

  • Present with confidence: present to clients on AI creative workflows.

Collaboration and process

  • Stay aligned: work closely with Producers, the Creative Director, and Product teams to ensure output is strategically aligned and technically feasible.

  • Shape the platform: provide feedback on platform and AI tools, workflows, and user experience to support ongoing product improvement.

  • Contribute ideas: help define how GenAI shapes Pencil’s approach to storytelling and design in internal creative discussions.

Innovation and growth

  • Stay current: keep up with emerging GenAI and design technologies, sharing insights and inspiration with the team.

  • Find better ways of working: identify new techniques and workflows that enhance speed, consistency, or creative quality.

  • Improve what exists: take initiative to improve creative systems, templates, and processes within your projects.

  • Keep growing: seek feedback proactively and apply it to grow both your craft and your creative judgment.

Your background

  • Experience as an Art Director or similar, ideally in advertising or digital production (essential).

  • Hands-on experience with GenAI creative tools across image, video and design generation (essential).

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud or equivalent design tools (essential).

  • Comfortable presenting creative work directly to clients (essential).

  • A strong eye for visual identity, brand consistency, and craft (essential).

  • Please be prepared to showcase your portfolio.

You’ll thrive here if you...

  • Detail-oriented: You can run multiple creative requests at once without letting quality slip.

  • A hands-on leader: You brief and review others’ work, but you’re still making things yourself.

  • Calm under pressure: Daily quality checks and client decks don’t rattle you.

  • Curious: You’re always exploring what new GenAI tools and techniques can do.

  • Collaborative: You work well across Producers, the Creative Director, and Product.

Your benefits

  • Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of GenAI.

  • Sponsored professional and personal learning allowance

  • Flexible vacation / time-off policy.

  • Competitive health insurance and welfare cover.

  • Fully remote work.
